title: Chapter 68: Midnight Ticket Counter
html:
The night before, on his way to Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy, Chen Ge had skimmed the three Daily Missions. The Easy Mission involved checking for hidden safety hazards; the Normal Mission required him to find a suitable site for expanding the Haunted House; and the Nightmare Mission asked him to identify the other presence sharing his room.

The Nightmare Mission naturally offered the greatest reward. However, judging by his previous two experiences, such missions had strict time limits, usually centered on midnight. Missing the window would likely cause an automatic failure.

No need to risk it.Chen Ge accepted the Normal Mission.

“Normal Mission: You have met the requirements for the Haunted House’s first expansion. Please find a suitable location as soon as possible!”

Chen Ge had never expanded the Haunted House before. He had no idea where to begin, and the black phone offered no instructions.

I can’t find a guide, so it looks like I’ll have to slowly research it on my own.Chen Ge looked at the interface of the app, and two places captured his attention.

My Team of Ghosts and Ghouls was still empty, meaning neither Zhang Ya nor Yin Xiaoxiao had officially joined the Haunted House. He probably had not earned enough of Xiaoxiao’s affection. As for Zhang Ya… Chen Ge would be grateful if she merely stopped trying to kill him. Asking her to join was out of the question.

The Haunted House Expansion tab also caught his attention. Its formerly gray text had turned red. When he tapped it, a sentence appeared on-screen.

“Please select the location of the entrance.”

If the words become red, it means that they’re clickable. The location of the entrance you say…

The underground lot was enormous, but its only entrance lay outside the park. The inconvenient route would never work for visitors, so he planned to open a passage beneath the Haunted House that led directly into it.

Large attractions such as roller coasters and Ferris wheels normally could not have usable space beneath them. The Haunted House, tucked into an isolated corner, was New Century Park’s sole exception; the parking lot extended directly beneath the building.

Black phone in hand, Chen Ge walked to the first-floor entrance of Night of the Living Dead. Since he acquired the one-star scenarios Minghun and Murder by Midnight, the old attraction had been all but abandoned.

I’ll set the door beside the entrance to this scenario. If it is necessary in the future, I can just remove and replace the Night of the Living Dead scenario.

With that plan in mind, Chen Ge marked an area on the floor with chalk. Only then did he realize he had no way to communicate his choice to the black phone. Ever since he received the mysterious device, communication had flowed in only one direction.

Am I missing something?Chen Ge tapped through the app. When he double-tapped the home page, the Haunted House in the background suddenly zoomed out into a floor plan. It matched the real building, down to the placement and layout of every scenario.

So, I do it here?

Chen Ge found the scenario for Night of the Living Dead on screen. He clicked on an empty space beside the entrance, and a question instantly popped up on screen.

“Are you sure you want to place the entrance here?”

“Yes.”

“Please select the expansion direction.”

“Downward.”

Once he made his choice, the screen returned to normal and several messages appeared.

“Only by continually expanding can your Haunted House shelter more homeless spirits and collect more screams. Congratulations on completing the Normal Mission. Reward obtained: one free spin of the Wheel of Misfortune!

“Congratulations on completing your first expansion. Special reward obtained—unique structure: Midnight Ticket Counter (Broken)!

“Midnight Ticket Counter (Broken): There’s a one in one thousand chance for you to attract special ‘visitors’. They are different from others and might lend you a helping hand.”

Chen Ge read the messages carefully. The mission had awarded him a free spin of the Wheel of Misfortune, but the reward involved far too much uncertainty. A normal spin cost one hundred Screams, and according to the phone’s description, the wheel did offer useful prizes.

Then again, even Chen Ge feared his own brand of ‘luck.’ What if he won another cursed love letter?

The two Baleful Specters might split him neatly in half so each could have an equal share. He pictured them clutching bloody knives and arguing over who got his head and who got his body.

Too soon, too soon.

He put the Wheel of Misfortune on the back burner and turned to his other reward: the broken Midnight Ticket Counter. The Haunted House had never needed a dedicated booth. Before the black phone, it received ten visitors in a good week.

The black phone has helped me solve a problem, but what is the meaning of this one in one thousand chance of attracting special visitors? Does it mean ghosts?

Chen Ge went to inspect the front entrance, but the gate looked exactly the same. Perhaps it won’t change until after midnight, like Murder by Midnight.

Since he had received the rewards, Chen Ge stopped worrying about them. He cleaned the place while waiting for midnight to arrive. Even though the mirror monster had been vanquished, it did not mean that the number on the mirror would disappear.

Chen Ge rolled up his sleeves as he cleaned the fake blood off the toilet’s mirror.

His urgency stemmed from a minor incident that afternoon. A visitor had asked to use the bathroom midway through the attraction. Chen Ge led him there, but the man took one look at the fake blood pooled across the floor and refused to enter. By the time Chen Ge escorted him outside, the poor visitor’s face had turned green from holding it in.

“The scary places should be scary, but other places should be as comfortable as possible. After all, we’re in the service business.”

That was some advice that Chen Ge’s father had once given him, and he remembered it to this day.

Chen Ge finished cleaning the fake blood at around 11 pm. He also fixed the broken toilet door. Then he stood before the mirror with his phone.

He checked his profile on the video-sharing app. His follower count was steadily rising, and viewers were sharing his videos widely. Several advertisers had already approached him with offers.

I need to pay attention to the videos and livestreams as well. After all, they’re my main source of promotion.

At 11:59 p.m., Chen Ge put away his phone and stood before the mirror. As in his first Nightmare Mission, he locked the bathroom from within and turned off every light.
